name: r013.cockpit_long_wait_activity_interrupt_bootstrap_mcw
description: Zero-credit R-013 setup route.  It binds a deterministic hostile fixture, reaches ordinary gameplay, and stops when the six-hour native wait exposes the current activity interruption.  It does not dispatch recovery.

proof_gates.label: R-013 source-bound long wait exposes a current native activity interruption

steps.label: post_load_r013_long_wait_bootstrap_hud
steps.abort_reason: the source-bound fixture did not reach ordinary gameplay

steps.label: observe_r013_long_wait_native_activity_interruption
steps.expected_visible_fact: each public action is issued from its current authorized observation; the six-hour native wait must expose a current hostile-sighting activity interruption and advertise activity.ignore, but this setup route does not dispatch it

evidence_contract.claim: the source-bound long-wait route reaches clean ordinary gameplay, issues the authorized public wait chain, and exposes a current native activity interruption that advertises activity.ignore; it grants zero gameplay credit and does not test recovery
evidence_contract.failure_rule: an active main-menu overlay, unavailable or reused observation identity, unadvertised action, rejected native receipt, absent native activity interruption, missing advertised activity.ignore, or failed cleanup leaves later R-013 validation unproved and receives no credit
